title: .github\workflows\filter-links.yml filters the non external links, too
author: zgabi
body_snippet:
When I (or even you) paste a github link to the issuse/comment, it is automatically replaced to:
[CENSORED!] Links to external GitHub repositories are not allowed

They are also replaced when the link is NOT external. See your own comments :)

comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet: @zgabi You're right — the `filter-links.yml` workflow is too aggressive. It's designed to prevent spam links but it also catches legitimate GitHub links in our own comments. We'll fix the filter regex to allow links to `github.com/robertpopa22/` and `github.com/mRemoteNG/` repositories.

comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
## Fixed in commit 75231b8

The regex in `filter-links.yml` was blocking ALL `github.com` repository URLs, including links to our own repo (`robertpopa22/mRemoteNG`) and upstream (`mRemoteNG/mRemoteNG`).

Added negative lookaheads to allowlist:
- `github.com/robertpopa22/mRemoteNG/*`
- `github.com/mRemoteNG/mRemoteNG/*`
- `github.com/user-attachments/assets/*` (already allowed — image uploads)

External repo links are still blocked as intended.
